# Pull Request Checklist

## Summary
- What does this change do?
- Why is it needed?

## Scope
- [ ] Small, focused change (no unrelated refactors)
- [ ] Touches the right layer (Core/Platform/Editor)

## Tests
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Tests run locally
- [ ] No tests needed (explain why)

## Docs
- [ ] Docs updated (if behavior, flags, presets, or workflow changed)
- [ ] No doc changes needed

## CI/Presets (if applicable)
- [ ] CMake presets updated if build behavior changed
- [ ] CI workflows updated if required

## Notes
- Risks or follow-ups
